residual_gap.text: The criterion admits self-attribution only 'where it is original'. Ordinal label smoothing with a fixed 0.15 of target mass moved to adjacent classes is an instance of soft ordinal labels / label-distribution learning (e.g., Diaz and Marathe, Soft Labels for Ordinal Regression, CVPR 2019), and adding lambda times the expected class distance to cross-entropy belongs to the known family of expected-cost or class-distance-aware CE penalties; neither is credibly 'introduced here'. Cite the prior families or describe both as variants. Minor: the first mentions of the temporal convolutional network (§4.3, lines 542-543) and of the cosine schedule (§1, line 204) carry no citation, which appears only at the later method descriptions.
